references.list: alphabetical; author initials (year): title. abbreviated journal volume, pages
references.in_text: author-year; first author et al. for >2 authors

files.figures: TIFF/JPEG; <=20 MB each; Arial; Arabic figure numbers/capital panels; captions in manuscript
files.resolution: mixed grayscale/bitmap >=600 dpi; color >=300 dpi; letters >=2 mm at final width
files.tables: native Word cells; single-spaced; no shading/color; no graph duplication
files.supplement: cite discrete items in main text; online support

reporting.statistics: exact n, exact p where relevant, F/df and t/df; tests described

submission.cover_letter: not explicitly mandatory on inspected guides
submission.AI: no dedicated instructions found on inspected guides; retain truthful transparency

fees.color: same primary page conflicts: EUR120 in Figures vs EUR100/page in Open access; confirm invoice

contradictions.handling: Use current journal-hosted genre-specific limits; flag legacy discrepancy.
Current journal checklist favors single spacing.

contradictions.primary: detailed guide requires separate files; generic checklist says inline
general methods requires statistics section; short communication prohibits headings
contradictions.handling: Retain complete statistical paragraph without heading.

indexing.journal_claim: Science Citation Index; Web of Science Core Collection
indexing.verification_limit: Publisher statement only; no independent Clarivate subscription-list verification.

data_integrity_notes: Do not add missing animal identities, qPCR controls or validation. Unheaded short format does not relax ethics/data reporting.
policy_priority: Current journal-hosted detailed article-specific instructions over generic checklist or undated older publisher text.
